skills.name: mern-stack-project
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user asks to scaffold, design, build, or review any part of a MERN stack application intended for production. Triggers include: "create a MERN project", "set up folder structure", "design the API", "build a REST endpoint", "add auth", "set up Express routes", "create a Mongoose model", "add middleware", "set up error handling", "write a controller", "add validation", or any request to generate backend or frontend code within a MERN context. Also trigger when the user shares existing MERN code and asks for a review, refactor, or production-readiness check. Always use this skill even if the user only asks about one part (e.g. just a model or just a route) — the standards here apply to every layer.

skills.name: frontend-reactjs
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user asks to scaffold, design, build, or review the React frontend of a MERN stack application. Triggers include: "set up the frontend", "create the frontend folder structure", "create a React component", "set up Redux Toolkit", "add a Redux slice", "create an API helper", "set up React Router", "create a custom hook", "set up Axios", "build a page component", "add global state", or any request to generate React / frontend code. Also trigger when the user shares existing frontend code and asks for a review, refactor, or production-readiness check. Always use this skill even if the user only asks about one part (e.g. just a slice or just a hook) — the standards here apply to every layer of the frontend.

skills.name: backend-expressjs
skills.description: Production-grade system for the Express / Node.js backend. Use this skill whenever the user asks to scaffold, design, build, extend, or review any part of a backend application. Triggers include: "add a new API", "create a route with middleware", "setup constants", "design a Mongoose model", "build a REST endpoint", "add authentication", or any request to generate Express/Node.js code. Use this skill even for isolated tasks (like adding one route or one constant) to ensure consistency with the established production standards.

skills.name: debug-reactjs-error
skills.description: Specialist skill for debugging React.js applications. Use this skill when the user encounters errors, bugs, or unexpected behavior in their React frontend. This skill implements a "Trace, Solve, Clean" workflow to ensure issues are resolved systematically and temporary debugging code is removed.

skills.name: debug-expressjs-error
skills.description: Specialist skill for debugging Express.js backend applications. Use this skill when the user encounters server-side errors, API failures, middleware issues, or database connectivity problems. This skill implements a "Trace, Solve, Clean" workflow to ensure issues are resolved systematically and temporary debugging code is removed.

skills.name: debug-mern-stack-error
skills.description: Specialist skill for debugging full-stack MERN (MongoDB, Express, React, Node) applications. Use this skill when the user encounters integration issues, authentication flows failing across layers, or general full-stack bugs. This skill implements a "Trace, Solve, Clean" workflow to ensure issues are resolved systematically across frontend and backend.

skills.name: debug-sailsjs-error
skills.description: Specialist skill for debugging Sails.js backend applications. Use this skill when the user encounters Sails.js-specific errors such as Waterline ORM issues (E_UNIQUE, E_INVALID_CRITERIA), action/helper failures (missing exits, E_MISSING_OR_INVALID_PARAMS), policy blocks (E_UNAUTHENTICATED, E_FORBIDDEN), or route misconfigurations. This skill implements a "Trace, Solve, Clean" workflow: identify the root cause, add targeted console.log statements, apply the fix, then remove all debug logs.

skills.name: sailsjs-api
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create a new API endpoint in Sails.js. Triggers include: any mention of "create API", "new endpoint", "add route", "controller action", "sails API", or requests to add new functionality to a Sails.js backend. This skill covers the FULL flow: controller action, sails helper, model validation, route registration, and policy setup.

skills.name: sailsjs-helper
skills.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create a Sails.js helper only — without building a full API endpoint. Triggers include: "create a helper", "add a helper", "write a sails helper", "new helper function", or when a user asks to extract logic into a reusable helper. Also trigger when the user mentions a sails helper name and wants to implement it.

skills.name: skill-creator
skills.description: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.

skills.name: prompt-writing
skills.description: Create, optimize, and refine high-quality AI prompts for various tasks. Use when the user wants to build a prompt for a chatbot, research agent, code assistant, or specialized task, or when they need to improve an existing prompt for better performance, accuracy, or format adherence.

skills.name: agent-workflow-creator
skills.description: Design, generate, document, and validate complete agent workflows for any task or domain. Use when the user wants to build an agent, design a workflow, automate a process, create a pipeline, map out task steps for AI execution, or define agent roles and tool sequences for a multi-step AI process.
